arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mastercard_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_brand = 'Mastercard'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions made with cards whose brand is Mastercard, over the full data period.
assumptions: Counts every transaction regardless of fraud label, error status, or sign of the amount.
Covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
